name: Trade Diversion and Third-Country Transshipment
description: Restricted goods or restricted-destination trade may be rerouted through third countries whose trade statistics, parties or documents show sudden shifts. Financial institutions can detect diversion by comparing customer activity with country-level trade patterns, end-use information and common high-priority items.

sources.text: FinCEN and BIS, Joint Alert: FinCEN and the US Department of Commerce's BIS Urge Increased Vigilance for Potential Russian and Belarusian Export Control Evasion Attempts (FIN-2022-Alert003, June 2022)
BIS and FinCEN, Joint Alert on Newly Identified Efforts by Russia to Evade Export Controls (2023)
FATF/Egmont Group, Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments (2020)
